labels: In a theatrical horror scene, both palms and both knees contact the floor beneath a low torso, with the head lifted toward an open doorway.; 연극적 호러 장면에서 낮은 몸통 아래 양 손바닥과 양 무릎이 바닥에 닿고 머리는 열린 문 방향으로 들린다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: In a theatrical horror scene, both palms and both knees contact the floor beneath a low torso, with the head lifted toward an open doorway.
